body: Material task-owned evidence-retention defect. Released workflow: a successful supported journey retains its durable workflow tree before test cleanup. Observable harm: cleanup overwrites the same read-only Git objects and false-fails a correct open-gate proof. value-ac[AC-2]: requires a green supported proof from retained durable evidence. Trigger: the frozen 43a1b8db4 Sonnet run regraded its first copy successfully, then failed on the cleanup copy. FIX authorized only for single-copy outcome ownership: direct success retention once, failure cleanup retention once when absent, and cleanup no-op when the retained directory exists.
